title: createRpcRouter
description: Installs figma.ui.onmessage and routes incoming UI RPC calls to atomic action handlers. Successful results with a requestId are sent back via sendToUi.

params.name: actions
params.description: Map of action name → async/sync handler function. Handlers receive params and should return a serializable result (typically { ok, ... }).

returns.description: No return value; wires the global onmessage handler as a side effect.
